question:
Select the most appropriate option to correct the sentence by using the proper meaning of the underlined word.

He scores good marks in exams as he is quite __meticulous__.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"meticulous"** means showing great attention to detail; very careful and precise. (सावधान)

 
 
• **Example: **She was **meticulous **in her preparation for the exam, ensuring every detail was covered.
 
 
 
• **"Careful"** refers to making sure of avoiding potential danger, mishap, or harm; cautious. (सावधान)
 
 
• **Example: **He was** careful **when crossing the busy street to avoid any accidents.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Lazy** (आलसी): Unwilling to work or use energy.

 
 
• **Example:** He is too** lazy **to clean his room.
 
 
 
• **Intelligent** (बुद्धिमान): Having or showing intelligence, especially of a high level.
 
 
• **Example:** She is very** intelligent **and excels in her studies.
 
 
 
• **Selective** (चयनात्मक): Relating to or involving the selection of the most suitable or best qualified.
 
 
• **Example:** He is very **selective** about the books he reads.
